limitation: This rerun verifies transfer atomicity and crash recovery against isolated temporary Stores. Canonical transport acceptance is separate and remains evidenced by canonical-store-path-grant-acceptance-20261011.json.

transfer_protocol.atomicity: One Store put_claim_batch publishes the source release record and recipient held record under the same expected claim generation.
transfer_protocol.conflict: Generation/version conflicts retry boundedly; competing transfers cannot both become the active owner.
transfer_protocol.provenance: Both records preserve the source version, request identity/digest, source and recipient sessions, reason, scope, and original lease acquisition/deadline.
transfer_protocol.retry: Stable transfer request identity binds the exact payload. A retry reads back and validates the paired committed records without appending a second transfer.
